name: Get Common Elements-1
html:
Dear Reader, today we will learn Get Common Elements-1 .

Hello there. Are you ready to conquer a new question? Let's go.


We want you to go through the problem statement and the question video to understand the problem better.


Important Links : Problem Link, Question Video , Solution Video

PROBLEM DISCUSSION

You are given 2 arrays a1 and a2 of size n1 and n2 respectively.

You are required to print all the elements of a2 which are also present in a1 (in order of their occurence in a2).

Make sure to not print duplicates (a2 may have the same value present multiple times).

Say, the given arrays are as shown in figure 1.

According to this question, the output should be: "1 2 5".

Approach :

We make a Hashmap table for every unique character of a1 vs. its frequency.

In figure 2, we iterate through every element of the array a1 and subsequently increase the frequency against it.

Now, we iterate through each element of the array a2. If that element is present in our Hashmap, then it is printed and the record of that element is removed from the hashmap as shown in figure 3. If the element is not present then we do nothing.

On iterating through all the elements of a2, the output obtained is as follows.

CODE

import java.io.*; import java.util.*; public class Main{ public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Scanner scn=new Scanner(System.in); int n1=scn.nextInt(); int[]a1=new int[n1]; for(int i=0;i hm=new HashMap(); for(int val: a1) { if(hm.containsKey(val)){ int old=hm.get(val); int now=old+1; hm.put(val,now); } else { hm.put(val,1); } } for(int val : a2){ if(hm.containsKey(val)) { System.out.println(val); hm.remove(val); } } } }
java; true"; TIME & SPACE COMPLEXITY TIME COMPLEXITY- O(n) SPACE COMPLEXITY- O(n) where n=number of entities in the hashmap.

The above code is quite straightforward. If you have any difficulties in understanding it, we suggest you to through the solution video of this question.
